annotations.title: Check if a site is blocked

description: Whether the AeonProxy gateway blocks a site or port by default for residential and mobile traffic: mail ports, .gov / .mil sites and listed banking, payment and ticketing sites; and whether the signed-in account has the site blocks lifted. It does not test whether the site itself accepts proxy traffic (fetch_via_proxy or test_proxies do).

host.description: site name or URL, e.g. paypal.com

name: check_site_access
